answer: Each task binds its nonce to a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse: only after the pulse is verified can the challenge be derived, so an attacker cannot precompute answers or farm a stockpile offline. Commit-reveal deadlines and fresh, single-use inputs require each claimant to respond to the same unpredictable event; labels such as gale, haven, and pearl add no advantage. This raises the cost of automated sybil swarms without claiming to eliminate them outright.
